name: The Canopy and the Tide

what_must_survive: Vertical relationship among suspended gardens, forest canopy and tidal settlement
Environmental design shapes everyday cultural life
No silent canon or world-identity merger
what_may_change: Landform topology and number of suspended islands
Placement of civic structures and transport links
Palette after individual Colour Pins are assessed
Fauna names and morphology after habitat review
what_can_be_lost: Decorative details that do not support a world rule
Unneeded elements of the initial concept
what_descendants_inherit: Zone relationships, hydrology open question, ecological constraints and provenance
what_world_can_teach: Worldbuilding decisions can be audited from inspiration through hypothesis to adopted canon

districts.name: Suspended Gardens
districts.water_question: Where does water originate and where does it return?

districts.name: Living Canopy
districts.function: multilevel settlement, habitat corridors and maintained grown structures

districts.name: Tideport
districts.function: estuary market, harbour access and watershed exchange

districts.name: Tidal Edge
districts.function: wetlands, nursery habitat and intertidal commons

palette_notice: Generated working colours, not sampled from Pinterest Colour Pins
unresolved_wonder: Why are the garden islands suspended, and what are their energy and water budgets?
How do storms alter vertical transport and habitat corridors?
What does the settlement cultivate, trade, and protect?
Which named species appear in source fauna references once reviewed?
What aspects belong in Terra Aeterna instead of remaining a separate visual experiment?
finish_line: One navigable spatial schematic with four districts, three credible ecological niches and an auditable reference palette; no canon or live world-route claim.
stop_point: Palette first pass assembled; review remaining 5–10 individual Pins across the other five sections before promotion.
next_owner: Rowan (selection and canon authority), ArcSweep Seedhouse (future review only)
